narrative.coaching_note: Lávese las manos con agua y jabón a los 8.1 segundos después de tocar bed rail A y antes de tocar phone. Este paso es muy importante para proteger a resident A y para no llevar gérmenes a otras superficies de la habitación. Usted tocó bed rail A a los 1.6 segundos y eso pasó contaminación a bare hand. Después usted tocó phone a los 8.1 segundos y la contaminación pasó a phone. Más tarde usted tocó a resident A a los 21.4 segundos y la contaminación pasó a resident A. Con C. difficile necesita usar agua y jabón porque el alcohol en gel no mata las esporas, así que lávese bien y no toque phone hasta terminar de lavarse. Si se hubiera lavado las manos en ese momento, se habrían mantenido limpios bare hand, gloved hand, phone y resident A.
narrative.audit_summary: Source was bed rail A. bare hand touched bed rail A at 1.6 seconds, with transfer from bed rail A to bare hand at 1.6 seconds, then to call button at 7.6 seconds, to phone at 8.1 seconds, and to resident A at 21.4 seconds, causing one exposure of resident A. Hand hygiene compliance was 0/2 opportunities: Moment 1 0/1 and Moment 5 0/1. Missed Moment 5 at 8.1 seconds and Moment 1 at 21.4 seconds. No hygiene events occurred; for C. difficile, alcohol rub does not kill spores and soap and water is required. No glove use issues were recorded. Contaminated at end were bare hand, gloved hand, bed rail A, call button, phone and resident A. Disinfect phone, bed rail A, call button and resident A with an EPA List K sporicidal disinfectant effective against C. difficile spores.
narrative.top_fix: The highest-impact single change in this clip was hand hygiene with soap and water at 8.1 seconds.
